title: Administrative penalty relief (First Time Abate and Automatic Exemption from Penalty)

passages.question: Is First Time Abate available for a Q2 2026 deposit penalty, and does HANGS's history qualify?
passages.excerpt: AEP begins summer 2026. Under AEP, if you file or pay late in the current year but have timely filed returns and paid tax due for the three prior years (or 12 consecutive quarters for quarterly filers), you won't be assessed a penalty. ... 2025 tax year returns, and subsequent 2026 quarterly returns, and subsequent ...
